Hints: Different inputs must not share an output.|Use the horizontal line test on a graph.
Solution: An inverse on the original function's range is a function exactly when the original is one-to-one: distinct inputs give distinct outputs. A horizontal line may meet its graph at most once. A parabola on all reals fails, but its right branch is one-to-one. The function must be one-to-one.

Question Answers: the range|range of the inverse|the range of f inverse
Hints: Inputs and outputs exchange roles.|The domain and range swap.
Solution: An inverse swaps the original domain and range. For f(x)=x^2, restrict the original domain to [0,infinity); its range and the domain and range of sqrt(x) are then [0,infinity).
